R2: Add verification command scripts to explicitly run the test and produce pointable test-run artifacts.

slices.title: Remediate missing E2E test criteria
slices.jtbd: When implementing the E2E test fixes for this epic, I want to enforce API call assertions and add verification artifacts, so that the original test coverage criteria are fully met.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh deployment pre-populated with sample 'Epidemiological Protocol' documents, When the E2E test downloads a document, Then it correctly hits the system API without try/catch gating.
Given this role completes the Atomic Goal, When the relevant verification command runs, Then the change passes and produces visible test-run artifacts that explicitly name the e2e test scope verified.
Given a blocker remains after one objective attempt, When the Jules session would otherwise loop, Then the agent stops and records one concrete blocker in the test or config file.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce false positive test pass rate from 100% to 0%
